summary: Validated (initially rejected because a correction may only name objects that are recorded uses of that knowledge revision; corrected to an empty affected_uses and revalidated → valid=true). Two linked products, source-only since this run's experiment capacity is exhausted. First, a durable correction attached to the existing knowledge id 296fcb…-knowledge-1 (now revision 2, with changed_premise): the originally recorded condition (c) — the leader's log no longer containing the entry below its snapshot index — is sufficient but not necessary. What decides convergence is whether the leader can build a request at the last index the two logs share, so a leader that compacted with a small TrailingLogs but still holds entries between the divergence point and the snapshot index produces the same repeating InstallSnapshot cycle, just with more rejected AppendEntries per snapshot round. The correction widens the trigger without changing the mechanism, participants or harmed endpoint. Second, a child reachability record (@q_index_ahead_reachability, parent = the snapshot question) showing each premise of the cycle has a producer in retained code: a superseded leader's uncommitted suffix survives on a minority because suffixes are only cleared inside the entry loop when terms conflict at an index the leader still holds (raft.go:1510-1535); a later majority without that suffix can elect a shorter-log leader (vote rule compares only voters' own last term/index, previously recorded); the snapshot index is the FSM's applied index, guarded only against being below the committed configuration index (fsm.go:216-232, snapshot.go:155-176), so it can sit below the old high-water mark; compaction deletes up to min(snapIdx, lastIdx-trailing) (snapshot.go:226-247), leaving the leader unable to repair the divergence, while the install rewrites FSM state and the region up to the snapshot index only. Recorded as a Fact plus a 'conditional' interpretation with the exclusions stated (suffix on a majority; large TrailingLogs letting the leader walk down; cached index not above the snapshot) and the honest limit that the composition was argued, not executed.
